policy: This rubric compiles decision-support suggestions for source-backed research history. Unknown funding, source access and project scope are never recast as negative proof. A held lead can be resolved as a bounded research *pass* without formally closing originals or their expansion. The pilot does not contact reviewers, publish Scout proposals, or write any downstream system.
